tool_input.command:
cat > .tmp_query.sql <<'SQL'
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpabef05e2.churntraining605fb7 AS
WITH tx AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) AS event_time, CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) AS amount, CAST(balance AS DOUBLE) AS balance
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabef05e2/rawdata/transactions.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT), CAST(amount AS DOUBLE), CAST(balance AS DOUBLE)
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabef05e2/rawdata/transactions_late.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
),
prof AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) AS event_time, CAST(credit_score AS INT) AS credit_score, CAST(tier AS STRING) AS tier
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabef05e2/rawdata/profiles.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
),
act AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) AS event_time, CAST(sessions_7d AS INT) AS sessions_7d
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabef05e2/rawdata/activity.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
),
hlth AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) AS event_time, CAST(health_score AS DOUBLE) AS health_score
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabef05e2/rawdata/account_health.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
),
lbl AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(label_time AS BIGINT) AS label_time, CAST(churned AS INT) AS churned
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpabef05e2/rawdata/labels.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)
),
tx_asof AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, t.amount, t.balance
  FROM lbl l JOIN tx t ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.event_time <= l.label_time
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY t.event_time DESC) = 1
),
prof_asof AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, p.credit_score, p.tier
  FROM lbl l JOIN prof p ON p.account_id = l.account_id AND p.event_time <= l.label_time
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY p.event_time DESC) = 1
),
act_asof AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, a.sessions_7d
  FROM lbl l JOIN act a ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND a.event_time <= l.label_time
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY a.event_time DESC) = 1
),
hlth_asof AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, h.health_score
  FROM lbl l JOIN hlth h ON h.account_id = l.account_id AND h.event_time <= l.label_time
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY h.event_time DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  l.account_id,
  l.label_time,
  t.amount,
  t.balance,
  p.credit_score,
  p.tier,
  a.sessions_7d,
  h.health_score,
  l.churned
FROM lbl l
LEFT JOIN tx_asof   t ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.label_time = l.label_time
LEFT JOIN prof_asof p ON p.account_id = l.account_id AND p.label_time = l.label_time
LEFT JOIN act_asof  a ON a.account_id = l.account_id AND a.label_time = l.label_time
LEFT JOIN hlth_asof h ON h.account_id = l.account_id AND h.label_time = l.label_time
SQL
databricks experimental aitools tools query "$(cat .tmp_query.sql)" 2>&1 | head -40
tool_input.description: Create training dataset table via point-in-time as-of join
